settings.question: Can I open and inspect the package before paying the courier?
settings.answer: Yes! Our courier policy allows you to inspect your items at your doorstep before paying. If you decide not to take it, you only pay the delivery fee.

settings.question: What payment methods are available?
settings.answer: We support Cash on Delivery (COD) across all Egyptian governorates, as well as Visa, Mastercard, Meeza, and ValU at checkout.

settings.question: How long does shipping take to my governorate?
settings.answer: Cairo & Giza: 24 to 48 hours. Alexandria & Delta: 2 to 3 days. Upper Egypt and Coastal governorates: 3 to 4 days.

settings.question: What is the 14-day exchange policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 14-day size replacement guarantee. Simply contact our WhatsApp customer care, and our courier will bring your new size to your doorstep.
